style.summary: Ladder's app runs on near-black #0E0E0E screens, with lime #E6FF01 on buttons, done checks, progress rings and chart bars. Workout cards are full-bleed coach photos with about 18 pt corners, titled in heavy extended caps. Controls are capsules: 34 pt chips with a grey rim and a 50 pt lime pill for the main action.

traits.label: Layout
traits.text: 16 to 19 pt side margins; a 7-day week row at a 54 pt pitch tops a swipeable 337 pt workout card.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Chips are 34 pt capsules, the main button a 50 pt pill, day marks 27 pt circles; photo cards round at about 18 pt.

traits.label: Color
traits.text: Near black #0E0E0E sits behind white text; lime #E6FF01 fills the main button, done days, progress rings and chart bars.

traits.label: Type
traits.text: EK Modena Extended Heavy caps, tracked about 4%, set headlines and stats like 186 lbs; SF Pro sets 13 to 15 pt UI text.

traits.label: Imagery
traits.text: Real coach photos appear on 6 of 8 shots, darkened at the bottom under white caps titles.

traits.label: Components
traits.text: A 31-tick lime rep gauge, about 62 pt avatar circles in lime progress rings, and a floating glass tab bar with 4 tabs.

trial.evidence: App Store description: “Try Ladder COMPLETELY FREE for 7 days. NO PAYMENT collected during trial.” Web pricing page: “FREE TRIAL 7 DAYS FREE” and “No payment info collected until AFTER your trial ends.”

ourRead: Annual leads with $14.99 a month, half of Monthly's $29.99, though $179.99 / 12 is $15.00. Only Annual gets a dark card and lime checks.
Annual costs less per month and does more: every team, unlimited team changes, unlimited Save & Replay. Monthly stops at 1 team and 2 changes a month.
The 7-day trial asks for payment only after it ends. The App Store lists 4 tiers at $179.99 to $479.99 a year; the web shows only PRO.
stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Ladder's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% white #FFFFFF: text and icons, plus onboarding and pricing pages.
- 30% near black #0E0E0E: in-app screens; #1C1C1E for cards and charts.
- 10% lime yellow #E6FF01: the main button, done checks, progress rings and chart bars.
Type:
- Headlines: Unbounded 800, close to EK Modena Extended, caps, +4% tracking, 26 to 32 pt.
- Body: Inter 400, close to SF Pro, 13 to 15 pt; Inter 700 for screen titles.
Shapes:
- 34 pt capsule chips with a #7D7D7D rim, a 50 pt pill main button, 27 pt day circles.
- Photo cards: 18 pt corners, a black gradient on the bottom third.
Layout:
- 16 pt side margins, 8 pt chip gaps, one workout card per view.
Components:
- Week row: 7 day circles, 54 pt pitch; done days fill lime with a black check.
- Avatar row: 62 pt photos in lime progress rings.
- Main button: full-width lime pill, black bold caps label.
Icons and imagery:
- White icons about 20 pt, filled in the tab bar. Real coach photos under white caps titles.
Check:
- In-app backgrounds are #0E0E0E or #1C1C1E.
- Lime marks only actions, progress and done states.
- Titles and big stats are in caps.
